description: Anchor table of contents that follows the visible section of a document.

howToUse: Use it next to a long page, such as documentation or terms, to jump between its sections.
List the sections in `items`, in the order of the page, with the `id` of each heading.
Turn on `scrollSpy` to mark the section being read, and `sticky` to keep the list on screen while scrolling.
alternatives: Going to other pages: SettingsSubnav or Sidebar.

keyboard.action: Moves from one section to the next.

props.name: items
props.description: Anchors, in the order they appear on the page.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active item; turns off the scrollspy.

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: Initial active item (uncontrolled). Default: first item.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fired when the active item changes (scrollspy or click).

props.name: scrollSpy
props.description: Turns on the scrollspy via IntersectionObserver (ignored if `activeId` is passed).

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: Reading band; vertical percentages relative to the container height.

props.name: root
props.description:
Scrollable container watched by the scrollspy (`root` of the
IntersectionObserver). Default: `null` (viewport). Pass the element with
`overflow-y: auto` when the scrolling is NOT the page's.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticks the rail while scrolling (`position: sticky`).
